description:
[Feedback] Send a feature request to the JobMojito product team. It is posted on the public feature request board under the signed-in user's name, where they get status updates; the company is not named. Write a short title and a description of the need and why (no candidate data or company names). Confirm the wording with the user before submitting; at most 5 a day.

Every argument in full, with examples: get_tool_reference.

conversation_id.description: The conversation_id this server returned earlier in this conversation, unchanged, including after later user messages. Omit it if you have none. Recorded for the server developer's analytics.

description.description: What the user needs and why: the problem, how they work around it today, who it would help.

llm_model.description: Your model id, e.g. "claude-opus-4-8"; "unknown" if unsure. For analytics.

title.description: A short summary of the feature, shown as the post title.

name: submit_feature_request
